title: Tacos with Refried Bean Filling
description: A classic Mexican dish with a crispy twist, featuring refried beans as the main filling.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook the crispy bacon slices until crispy, then set aside.
In the same skillet, warm the refried beans over low heat.
In a separate pan, warm the tortillas over medium heat for about 30 seconds on each side.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the refried beans onto a tortilla, followed by a slice of cheese and a sprinkle of crispy bacon.
Optional: top with diced onions, cilantro, or salsa to taste.
